quote: You keep searching for peace in crowded rooms, while your own soul begs for silence. Every distraction you chase only deepens the quiet ache inside your chest. We trade our stillness for fleeting comfort, forgetting that true healing happens alone. Stop running from the heavy thoughts waiting in the dark. The answers you need were buried beneath your noise all along.
